sourceNotes: 新增 Apple 智能只读诊断
聚合模式仅展示所选菜单栏指标，开启进程功能不再自动追加高占用进程排行或额外采样
进程功能设置新增资源开销说明，开启前即可了解刷新列表带来的 CPU 等资源消耗
统一使用“聚合模式”名称，更新功能介绍与截图，方便了解菜单栏布局和可选组件的使用方式
修复 Apple 智能诊断在超时或取消后可能卡住、以及空或损坏报告被解析为异常的问题

en: Add read-only Apple Intelligence diagnostics in System Information and process explanations, separating feature configuration from on-device model availability and disk usage; full feature and model-usage detection requires macOS 27 or later, and no settings are changed or models downloaded or deleted

Show only selected menu bar metrics in Aggregate Mode; enabling Processes no longer adds a top-process card or process sampling to the collapsed overview, while CPU, memory and disk details retain their on-demand process data
Explain the CPU and other resource cost of refreshing the process list in Features settings, before enabling it
Use the Aggregate Mode name consistently and refresh feature documentation and screenshots to explain menu bar layouts and optional components
Fix Apple Intelligence diagnostics that could stall after timeout or cancellation or treat empty and malformed reports as errors; stop reads and reclaim the diagnostic child process when dismissed
